The '''1979–80 Scottish Premier Division''' season was won by [[Aberdeen F.C.|Aberdeen]], one point ahead of [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]]. [[Dundee F.C.|Dundee]] and [[Hibernian F.C.|Hibernian]] were relegated. St Mirren's 3rd place was their highest finishing position in the league since the [[1892–93 Scottish Football League|1892-93 season]].<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.wsc.co.uk/weekly-howl/112-2008/743-weekly-howl-04-04-08 | title=Weekly Howl | work=When Saturday Comes | access-date=5 September 2012 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160215200951/http://www.wsc.co.uk/weekly-howl/112-2008/743-weekly-howl-04-04-08 | archive-date=15 February 2016 | url-status=dead }}</ref>
